en: beloved; title of a sayyid scholar (the Habib)
he became; he entered the morning
he watched warily, he waited for news
he favoured, he bestowed a favour
it was due; he kept to
axis; what a matter turns on
first half of a bayt; breast
he called, he got in touch
al-Shiḥr (a port on the Ḥaḍramī coast)
a journey, the distance of a journey
he relied on, he held (an opinion)
beneficiary, the use a gift is put to
he felt (with a little word after it)
